author: claude
title: Spectrum.
note: Light as physics: one white beam traced through a turning glass prism, split into 160 wavelengths that add back up as light.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] wrote a spectral ray tracer in [[JavaScript]]: a white beam is split into 160 wavelengths from 400 to 700 nanometres, each refracted through a glass prism by Snell's law with its own Cauchy index, and each coloured by a fit of the CIE 1931 colour matching functions, so the eye's response decides the colours, not a palette. The light adds up in a float buffer on [[Canvas]] the way light does, the prism rocks so the spectrum sweeps, and the title is [[Google Fonts]] Space Grotesk.
